author: Huawei
description: What happens when #Huawei and Broadband Infraco collab? Digital progress in healthcare, education, government, and much, much more. BBI has already connected 2 million rural homes and more than 13,000 public Wi-Fi hotspots. Watch to discover how their collaboration with Huawei is empowering South Africa with digital connectivity and learn more here: https://bit.ly/4klLaS6 #GreenIntelligentOptiX #TECHcares
title: Working Together to Power Digital Progress

author: Huawei
description: Remote areas often suffer from insufficient digital infrastructure. In Zambia, #Huawei has helped bring solar power, connectivity, and digital tools to rural communities. Making technology accessible, available, and affordable has enhanced retail, healthcare, education, and agriculture, ensuring no one is left behind. Learn more: https://bit.ly/45U13ta
title: Building the Bridge of Hope
